g.text: Automatic Core → Circuit JSON → CLI → JLCPCB | no manual offsets
Actual JLCPCB 3D captures. C81598 diode + C916374 SOT-23. Same 24 × 16 mm copper and pad geometry.
Gold rings identify expected Circuit JSON pad 1. No rotate, translate or auto-align was used in JLCPCB.
REPRO | automatic supplier CAD, wrong side angle
D4 band faces pad 2; U4 two-lead side misses the upper pads.
FIX | automatic supplier CAD + correct side angle
D4 cathode and U4 numbered lead frame match the board pads.
Exact fixed CSV extracted from the CLI fabrication ZIP
Bottom CSV = normalize(−PCB angle + CAD difference)
Factory zero is absent, not a manually supplied +180°.
Top-side controls align in the separate raw top capture. Native CAD Euler z is not a vendor CSV angle.
The live supplier response contains no factory assembly offset. CLI warns; unknown stays distinct from confirmed zero.
Both TSX and prebuilt JSON exports produce these identical CSV bytes. No order or payment was submitted.
